tools.name: Claude Code / Codex / Cursor
tools.detail: 'Works with any coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ...)'

claims: Describe your deck in plain English; the agent writes React code handling layout and animation
Click any element in the browser, leave a comment like 'make this red', agent applies it without you touching code
Handles runtime: scaling, navigation, hot reload, present mode
Professional presentable deck from a one-line prompt
Every slide renders on a fixed 1920x1080 canvas; pages are arbitrary React components, not a constrained DSL
how_to_steps: In your coding agent run /create-slide and answer the four scoping questions
Open the dev server, click elements and attach comments ('make this red', 'shrink the headline'); comments persist as .slide-comment markers
Run /apply-comments so the agent applies pending edits and clears markers
Loop: present -> click to comment -> /apply-comments -> repeat
on_screen_only: GitHub README for open-slide: 'The slide framework built for agents. Describe your deck in natural language -- your coding agent writes the React. open-slide handles the canvas, scaling, navigation, hot reload, and present mode so the agent can focus on content.'

Highlights: 'Agent-native authoring', 'In-browser inspector', 'Assets manager + svgl logo search' ('Manage images, videos, and fonts per deck through an assets panel. Search and drop in any brand logo via svgl')
Stars 9.8K, Forks 621, License MIT; badge 'VERCEL INC. // 2026 OPEN SOURCE SOFTWARE PROGRAM'

relevance.why: Pitch decks, investor updates and client proposals are recurring founder chores; a Claude Code-native deck generator with a visual comment loop fits the existing workflow and is Vercel-backed OSS.
